```{r}
# Cargar datos y separar Surface y Bottom
datos_fusionados <- read.csv("~/Documents/Edgart_Flores/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/Diversity/combined_data_only_IPL_envriomental.csv")
datos_surface <- datos_fusionados %>% filter(grepl("Surface", ID))
datos_bottom <- datos_fusionados %>% filter(grepl("Bottom", ID))
```

```{r}
# Ahora Surface (siguiendo el mismo patrón que Bottom)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)

# Agrupar columnas por clase de lípidos
lipid_groups <- list(
  PG = grep("^PG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PE = grep("^PE\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PC = grep("^PC\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PME = grep("^PME\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PDME = grep("^PDME\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  MGDG = grep("^MGDG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGDG = grep("^DGDG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  SQDG = grep("^SQDG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGTS = grep("^DGTS\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGTA = grep("^DGTA\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGCC = grep("^DGCC\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  Other = grep("^(Gly\\.Cer\\.|PI\\.)", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE)
)

# Preparamos los datos calculando la suma de cada grupo
datos_surface_processed <- datos_surface %>%
  mutate(
    Mesocosm = case_when(
      grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
      grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
      grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
      grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Extraer número de día
    Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
  )

# Calculamos la suma de cada grupo de lípidos
for (group_name in names(lipid_groups)) {
  if (length(lipid_groups[[group_name]]) > 0) {
    # Crear suma para cada grupo
    datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] <- rowSums(datos_surface_processed[, lipid_groups[[group_name]], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    # Si no hay columnas para este grupo, asignar cero
    datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] <- 0
  }
}

# Calcular el total para obtener porcentajes
lipid_columns <- names(lipid_groups)
datos_surface_processed$Total <- rowSums(datos_surface_processed[, lipid_columns], na.rm = TRUE)

# Calcular porcentajes
for (group_name in lipid_columns) {
  datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] <- (datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] / datos_surface_processed$Total) * 100
}

# Ahora sí tenemos lipidos_surface_porcentajes
lipidos_surface_porcentajes <- datos_surface_processed

# Convertir a formato largo para graficar
lipids_surface_for_plotting <- lipidos_surface_porcentajes %>%
  # Extract columns already exists
  # Convert to long format for plotting
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(PG, PE, PC, PME, PDME, MGDG, DGDG, SQDG, DGTS, DGTA, DGCC, Other),
    names_to = "Lipid_Category",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  )

# Order factors to appear in the correct order
lipids_surface_for_plotting$Lipid_Category <- factor(
  lipids_surface_for_plotting$Lipid_Category,
  levels = c("PG", "PE", "PC", "PME", "PDME", "MGDG", "DGDG", "SQDG", "DGTS", "DGTA", "DGCC", "Other")
)

# Create a colorblind-friendly RdBu palette with more subtle tones
# Get a modified RdBu palette with 12 colors
lipid_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(12)

# Function to create plots for each mesocosm (CON MARCO)
plot_mesocosm <- function(mesocosm_number) {
  filtered_data <- lipids_surface_for_plotting %>%
    filter(Mesocosm == paste("Mesocosm", mesocosm_number))
  
  # Check if there's data
  if(nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + 
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste("No data for Mesocosm", mesocosm_number)) + 
             theme_void())
  }
  
  # Get the unique days in the dataset
  days <- sort(unique(filtered_data$Day))
  
  # Create the plot using numeric x-axis instead of factor
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Day, y = Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +  # Width less than 2 creates gaps
    scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(days) + 10, by = 10),  # Show ticks every 10 days
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x %% 10 == 0, paste("Day", x), ""),  # Only show labels for multiples of 10
      limits = c(min(days) - 2, max(days) + 2)  # Add space at edges
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lipid Composition in Mesocosm", mesocosm_number, "(Surface)"),
      x = "",  # Remove x-axis title
      y = "Percentage (%)",
      fill = "Lipid Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),  # Horizontal labels
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      # Agregar el marco/borde
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      # Asegurar que los ejes también tienen color
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# Create individual plots
plot_surface_meso6 <- plot_mesocosm(6)
plot_surface_meso7 <- plot_mesocosm(7)
plot_surface_meso5 <- plot_mesocosm(5)
plot_surface_meso8 <- plot_mesocosm(8)

combined_surface_plot <- grid.arrange(
  plot_surface_meso6, plot_surface_meso7,  # Primera fila: Mesocosm 6 y 7
  plot_surface_meso5, plot_surface_meso8,  # Segunda fila: Mesocosm 5 y 8
  ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
  top = "Lipid Composition in Surface Samples"
)
print(combined_surface_plot)
```
```{r}
# Calcular el promedio de los cuatro mesocosmos para cada día y categoría de lípido (SURFACE)
lipids_surface_average <- lipids_surface_for_plotting %>%
  # Agrupar por día y categoría de lípido
  group_by(Day, Lipid_Category) %>%
  # Calcular el promedio del porcentaje
  summarise(Avg_Percentage = mean(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Asegurarnos que cada día suma 100%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calcular la suma total por día
    Day_Total = sum(Avg_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Ajustar el porcentaje para asegurar que sume 100%
    Adjusted_Percentage = (Avg_Percentage / Day_Total) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verificar que cada día suma 100%
sum_check_surface <- lipids_surface_average %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  summarise(Sum_Percentage = sum(Adjusted_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE))
print(sum_check_surface)

# Get the unique days in the dataset
days <- sort(unique(lipids_surface_average$Day))

# Crear el plot promedio para superficie con espacios entre barras
average_surface_plot <- ggplot(lipids_surface_average, aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +  # Width less than 2 creates gaps
  scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days) + 10, by = 10),  # Show ticks every 10 days
    labels = function(x) ifelse(x %% 10 == 0, x, ""),  # Only show labels for multiples of 10
    limits = c(min(days) - 2, max(days) + 2)  # Add space at edges
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Lipid Composition Across All Mesocosms (Surface)",
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Lipid Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),  # Horizontal labels
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

# Guardar el plot para usarlo después
surface_plot <- average_surface_plot
print(surface_plot)
```

```{r}
# Ahora Bottom CON MARCOS

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)

# Agrupar columnas por clase de lípidos
lipid_groups <- list(
  PG = grep("^PG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PE = grep("^PE\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PC = grep("^PC\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PME = grep("^PME\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PDME = grep("^PDME\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  MGDG = grep("^MGDG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGDG = grep("^DGDG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  SQDG = grep("^SQDG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGTS = grep("^DGTS\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGTA = grep("^DGTA\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGCC = grep("^DGCC\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  Other = grep("^(Gly\\.Cer\\.|PI\\.)", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE)
)

# Preparamos los datos calculando la suma de cada grupo
datos_bottom_processed <- datos_bottom %>%
  mutate(
    Mesocosm = case_when(
      grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
      grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
      grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
      grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Extraer número de día
    Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
  )

# Calculamos la suma de cada grupo de lípidos
for (group_name in names(lipid_groups)) {
  if (length(lipid_groups[[group_name]]) > 0) {
    # Crear suma para cada grupo
    datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] <- rowSums(datos_bottom_processed[, lipid_groups[[group_name]], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    # Si no hay columnas para este grupo, asignar cero
    datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] <- 0
  }
}

# Calcular el total para obtener porcentajes
lipid_columns <- names(lipid_groups)
datos_bottom_processed$Total <- rowSums(datos_bottom_processed[, lipid_columns], na.rm = TRUE)

# Calcular porcentajes
for (group_name in lipid_columns) {
  datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] <- (datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] / datos_bottom_processed$Total) * 100
}

# Convertir a formato largo para graficar
lipids_bottom_for_plotting <- datos_bottom_processed %>%
  select(ID, Mesocosm, Day, all_of(lipid_columns)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(lipid_columns),
    names_to = "Lipid_Category",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  )

# Ordenar factores para que aparezcan en el orden correcto
lipids_bottom_for_plotting$Lipid_Category <- factor(
  lipids_bottom_for_plotting$Lipid_Category,
  levels = lipid_columns
)

# Crear una paleta de colores
lipid_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(length(lipid_columns))

# Función para crear gráficos para cada mesocosm con espacios entre barras Y MARCOS
plot_mesocosm_bottom <- function(mesocosm_number) {
  filtered_data <- lipids_bottom_for_plotting %>%
    filter(Mesocosm == paste("Mesocosm", mesocosm_number))
  
  # Verificar si hay datos
  if(nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + 
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste("No data for Mesocosm", mesocosm_number)) + 
             theme_void())
  }
  
  # Get the unique days in the dataset
  days <- sort(unique(filtered_data$Day))
  
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Day, y = Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +  # Width less than 2 creates gaps
    scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(days) + 10, by = 10),  # Show ticks every 10 days
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x %% 10 == 0, x, ""),  # Only show labels for multiples of 10
      limits = c(min(days) - 2, max(days) + 2)  # Add space at edges
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lipid Composition in Mesocosm", mesocosm_number, "(Bottom)"),
      x = "",  # Eliminar título del eje x
      y = "Percentage (%)",
      fill = "Lipid Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),  # Horizontal labels
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      # ESTAS SON LAS LÍNEAS IMPORTANTES PARA LOS MARCOS
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# Crear gráficos individuales
plot_bottom_meso5 <- plot_mesocosm_bottom(5)
plot_bottom_meso6 <- plot_mesocosm_bottom(6)
plot_bottom_meso7 <- plot_mesocosm_bottom(7)
plot_bottom_meso8 <- plot_mesocosm_bottom(8)

# Combinar los gráficos
combined_bottom_plot <- grid.arrange(plot_bottom_meso6, plot_bottom_meso7, 
                                     plot_bottom_meso5, plot_bottom_meso8, 
                                    ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                                    top = "Lipid Composition in Bottom Samples")
print(combined_bottom_plot)
```

#Urnir figuras promedio surface vs subsurface


```{r}
# Orden: 5 fosfolípidos (rojos), 3 glicolípidos (azules), 3 betaínas (morados), 1 Other (gris)
lipid_order <- c("PG", "PE", "PC", "PME", "PDME",   # Phospholipids
                  "MGDG", "DGDG", "SQDG",            # Glycolipids
                  "DGTS", "DGTA", "DGCC",             # Betaine lipids
                  "Other")

lipid_groups_palette <- c(
  # Phospholipids - reds
  "PG"    = "#a11d1d",
  "PE"    = "#c72626",
  "PC"    = "#e33a3a",
  "PME"   = "#ed7777",
  "PDME"  = "#f7b2b2",
  # Glycolipids - blues
  "MGDG"  = "#2e75b6",
  "DGDG"  = "#5c9ad1",
  "SQDG"  = "#9fc5e8",
  # Betaine lipids - purples
  "DGTS"  = "#6a329f",
  "DGTA"  = "#8e7cc3",
  "DGCC"  = "#b4a7d6",
  # Other - grey
  "Other" = "#b0b0b0"
)
```

```{r}
lipids_surface_for_plotting$Lipid_Category <- factor(lipids_surface_for_plotting$Lipid_Category, levels = lipid_order)
lipids_bottom_for_plotting$Lipid_Category  <- factor(lipids_bottom_for_plotting$Lipid_Category,  levels = lipid_order)

lipids_bottom_average$Lipid_Category  <- factor(lipids_bottom_average$Lipid_Category,  levels = lipid_order)
```

```{r}
if (!require("patchwork")) install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)

# --- Usar variables de días independientes para evitar que se sobrescriban ---
days_surface <- sort(unique(lipids_surface_average$Day))
days_bottom  <- sort(unique(lipids_bottom_average$Day))

phase_breaks <- c(11, 19, 37)

# --- Panel A: Surface (sin eje X, va arriba) ---
surface_plot_combined <- ggplot(lipids_surface_average, aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_groups_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days_surface) + 10, by = 10),
    limits = c(min(days_surface) - 2, max(days_surface) + 2)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative Abundance (%)", fill = "Lipid Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),      # sin etiquetas de día arriba
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

# --- Panel B: Subsurface (con eje X, va abajo) ---
bottom_plot_combined <- ggplot(lipids_bottom_average, aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_groups_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days_bottom) + 10, by = 10),
    limits = c(min(days_bottom) - 2, max(days_bottom) + 2)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", fill = "Lipid Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

# --- Franja delgada entre A y B con las etiquetas de fase ---
phase_positions <- c(mean(c(0, 11)), mean(c(11, 19)), mean(c(19, 37)), mean(c(37, max(days_bottom) + 2)))
phase_labels_plot <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = phase_positions, y = 0,
           label = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
           size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(days_bottom) - 2, max(days_bottom) + 2)) +
  theme_void()

# --- Combinar todo con patchwork ---
final_lipid_plot <- surface_plot_combined / phase_labels_plot / bottom_plot_combined +
  plot_layout(heights = c(10, 0.6, 10), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_lipid_plot <- final_lipid_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "", "B"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(final_lipid_plot)

# Guardar en alta resolución para el paper
ggsave("Figure3_Lipid_Composition_Surface_Subsurface.tiff",
       final_lipid_plot, width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
ggsave("Figure3_Lipid_Composition_Surface_Subsurface.pdf",
       final_lipid_plot, width = 8, height = 9)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 0. LIBRERÍAS
# ============================================================
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse, openxlsx, readxl, here, janitor,
  ggthemes, gridExtra, RColorBrewer, scales, cowplot,
  ggdendro, ggpubr, ggpmisc, ggsci, latex2exp,
  broom, vegan, pvclust, cluster, factoextra,
  multcompView, FD, ade4, gclus,
  magrittr, reshape2, dendextend, graphics, devtools,
  patchwork
)

# ============================================================
# 1. CARGAR DATOS
# ============================================================
datos_fusionados <- read.csv("~/Documents/Edgart_Flores/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/Diversity/combined_data_only_IPL_envriomental.csv")
datos_surface <- datos_fusionados %>% filter(grepl("Surface", ID))
datos_bottom  <- datos_fusionados %>% filter(grepl("Bottom", ID))

# ============================================================
# 2. PALETA Y ORDEN DE CATEGORÍAS (agrupada por clase biológica)
# ============================================================
lipid_order <- c("PG", "PE", "PC", "PME", "PDME",   # Phospholipids
                  "MGDG", "DGDG", "SQDG",            # Glycolipids
                  "DGTS", "DGTA", "DGCC",             # Betaine lipids
                  "Other")

lipid_groups_palette <- c(
  "PG"    = "#a11d1d", "PE"   = "#c72626", "PC"   = "#e33a3a",
  "PME"   = "#ed7777", "PDME" = "#f7b2b2",
  "MGDG"  = "#2e75b6", "DGDG" = "#5c9ad1", "SQDG" = "#9fc5e8",
  "DGTS"  = "#6a329f", "DGTA" = "#8e7cc3", "DGCC" = "#b4a7d6",
  "Other" = "#b0b0b0"
)

class_colors <- c("Phospholipids" = "#7a0000", "Glycolipids" = "#003d7a", "Betaine_lipids" = "#3d0066")

# ============================================================
# 3. PROCESAR SURFACE -> lipids_surface_for_plotting / lipids_surface_average
# ============================================================
lipid_groups_surface <- list(
  PG = grep("^PG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PE = grep("^PE\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PC = grep("^PC\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PME = grep("^PME\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  PDME = grep("^PDME\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  MGDG = grep("^MGDG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGDG = grep("^DGDG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  SQDG = grep("^SQDG\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGTS = grep("^DGTS\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGTA = grep("^DGTA\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  DGCC = grep("^DGCC\\.", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE),
  Other = grep("^(Gly\\.Cer\\.|PI\\.)", colnames(datos_surface), value = TRUE)
)

datos_surface_processed <- datos_surface %>%
  mutate(
    Mesocosm = case_when(
      grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
      grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
      grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
      grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
  )

for (group_name in names(lipid_groups_surface)) {
  if (length(lipid_groups_surface[[group_name]]) > 0) {
    datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] <- rowSums(datos_surface_processed[, lipid_groups_surface[[group_name]], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] <- 0
  }
}

lipid_columns <- names(lipid_groups_surface)
datos_surface_processed$Total <- rowSums(datos_surface_processed[, lipid_columns], na.rm = TRUE)
for (group_name in lipid_columns) {
  datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] <- (datos_surface_processed[[group_name]] / datos_surface_processed$Total) * 100
}

lipids_surface_for_plotting <- datos_surface_processed %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(lipid_columns), names_to = "Lipid_Category", values_to = "Percentage")

lipids_surface_for_plotting$Lipid_Category <- factor(lipids_surface_for_plotting$Lipid_Category, levels = lipid_order)

lipids_surface_average <- lipids_surface_for_plotting %>%
  group_by(Day, Lipid_Category) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Percentage = mean(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(Day_Total = sum(Avg_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
         Adjusted_Percentage = (Avg_Percentage / Day_Total) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

lipids_surface_average$Lipid_Category <- factor(lipids_surface_average$Lipid_Category, levels = lipid_order)

# ============================================================
# 4. PROCESAR BOTTOM -> lipids_bottom_for_plotting / lipids_bottom_average
# ============================================================
lipid_groups_bottom <- list(
  PG = grep("^PG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PE = grep("^PE\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PC = grep("^PC\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PME = grep("^PME\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  PDME = grep("^PDME\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  MGDG = grep("^MGDG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGDG = grep("^DGDG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  SQDG = grep("^SQDG\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGTS = grep("^DGTS\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGTA = grep("^DGTA\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  DGCC = grep("^DGCC\\.", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE),
  Other = grep("^(Gly\\.Cer\\.|PI\\.)", colnames(datos_bottom), value = TRUE)
)

datos_bottom_processed <- datos_bottom %>%
  mutate(
    Mesocosm = case_when(
      grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
      grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
      grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
      grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
  )

for (group_name in names(lipid_groups_bottom)) {
  if (length(lipid_groups_bottom[[group_name]]) > 0) {
    datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] <- rowSums(datos_bottom_processed[, lipid_groups_bottom[[group_name]], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] <- 0
  }
}

datos_bottom_processed$Total <- rowSums(datos_bottom_processed[, lipid_columns], na.rm = TRUE)
for (group_name in lipid_columns) {
  datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] <- (datos_bottom_processed[[group_name]] / datos_bottom_processed$Total) * 100
}

lipids_bottom_for_plotting <- datos_bottom_processed %>%
  select(ID, Mesocosm, Day, all_of(lipid_columns)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(lipid_columns), names_to = "Lipid_Category", values_to = "Percentage")

lipids_bottom_for_plotting$Lipid_Category <- factor(lipids_bottom_for_plotting$Lipid_Category, levels = lipid_order)

lipids_bottom_average <- lipids_bottom_for_plotting %>%
  group_by(Day, Lipid_Category) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Percentage = mean(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(Day_Total = sum(Avg_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
         Adjusted_Percentage = (Avg_Percentage / Day_Total) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

lipids_bottom_average$Lipid_Category <- factor(lipids_bottom_average$Lipid_Category, levels = lipid_order)

# ============================================================
# 5. CONCENTRACIONES TOTALES POR CLASE AMPLIA (Phospho / Glyco / Betaine)
# ============================================================
compute_class_totals <- function(datos_raw, lipid_groups) {
  df <- datos_raw %>%
    mutate(
      Mesocosm = case_when(
        grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
        grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
        grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
        grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
    )

  df$Phospholipids  <- rowSums(df[, c(lipid_groups$PG, lipid_groups$PE, lipid_groups$PC,
                                       lipid_groups$PME, lipid_groups$PDME)], na.rm = TRUE)
  df$Glycolipids    <- rowSums(df[, c(lipid_groups$MGDG, lipid_groups$DGDG, lipid_groups$SQDG)], na.rm = TRUE)
  df$Betaine_lipids <- rowSums(df[, c(lipid_groups$DGTS, lipid_groups$DGTA, lipid_groups$DGCC)], na.rm = TRUE)

  df %>% select(ID, Mesocosm, Day, Phospholipids, Glycolipids, Betaine_lipids)
}

class_totals_surface <- compute_class_totals(datos_surface, lipid_groups_surface) %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  summarise(
    Phospholipids  = mean(Phospholipids, na.rm = TRUE),
    Glycolipids    = mean(Glycolipids, na.rm = TRUE),
    Betaine_lipids = mean(Betaine_lipids, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Phospholipids, Glycolipids, Betaine_lipids),
               names_to = "Class", values_to = "Total_Concentration") %>%
  mutate(Total_Concentration = Total_Concentration / 1000)  # ng/L -> µg/L

class_totals_bottom <- compute_class_totals(datos_bottom, lipid_groups_bottom) %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  summarise(
    Phospholipids  = mean(Phospholipids, na.rm = TRUE),
    Glycolipids    = mean(Glycolipids, na.rm = TRUE),
    Betaine_lipids = mean(Betaine_lipids, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Phospholipids, Glycolipids, Betaine_lipids),
               names_to = "Class", values_to = "Total_Concentration") %>%
  mutate(Total_Concentration = Total_Concentration / 1000)  # ng/L -> µg/L

max_conc_global <- max(class_totals_surface$Total_Concentration,
                        class_totals_bottom$Total_Concentration, na.rm = TRUE)

class_totals_surface <- class_totals_surface %>%
  mutate(Scaled_Concentration = (Total_Concentration / max_conc_global) * 100)

class_totals_bottom <- class_totals_bottom %>%
  mutate(Scaled_Concentration = (Total_Concentration / max_conc_global) * 100)

# ============================================================
# 6. PANELES (Surface y Bottom) CON BARRAS + LÍNEAS + EJE Y SECUNDARIO
# ============================================================
phase_breaks  <- c(11, 19, 37)
days_surface  <- sort(unique(lipids_surface_average$Day))
days_bottom   <- sort(unique(lipids_bottom_average$Day))

surface_plot_combined <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = lipids_surface_average,
           aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category),
           stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = class_totals_surface,
            aes(x = Day, y = Scaled_Concentration, color = Class, group = Class),
            linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = class_totals_surface,
             aes(x = Day, y = Scaled_Concentration, color = Class), size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_groups_palette, name = "Lipid Category") +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Total Concentration") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days_surface) + 10, by = 10),
    limits = c(min(days_surface) - 2, max(days_surface) + 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max_conc_global / 100,
                         name = expression(paste("Total Concentration (", mu, "g L"^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

bottom_plot_combined <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = lipids_bottom_average,
           aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category),
           stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = class_totals_bottom,
            aes(x = Day, y = Scaled_Concentration, color = Class, group = Class),
            linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = class_totals_bottom,
             aes(x = Day, y = Scaled_Concentration, color = Class), size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_groups_palette, name = "Lipid Category") +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Total Concentration") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days_bottom) + 10, by = 10),
    limits = c(min(days_bottom) - 2, max(days_bottom) + 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max_conc_global / 100,
                         name = expression(paste("Total Concentration (", mu, "g L"^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Day") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. FRANJA DE FASES (ARRIBA) + ENSAMBLAJE FINAL CON PATCHWORK
# ============================================================
phase_positions <- c(mean(c(0, 11)), mean(c(11, 19)), mean(c(19, 37)),
                      mean(c(37, max(days_bottom) + 2)))

phase_labels_plot <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = phase_positions, y = 0,
           label = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
           size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(days_bottom) - 2, max(days_bottom) + 2)) +
  theme_void()

final_lipid_plot <- phase_labels_plot / surface_plot_combined / bottom_plot_combined +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.5, 10, 10), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_lipid_plot <- final_lipid_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("", "A", "B"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(final_lipid_plot)
```

```{r}
# Función para crear gráficos para cada mesocosm (CON MARCO)
plot_mesocosm <- function(mesocosm_number) {
  filtered_data <- lipids_surface_for_plotting %>%
    filter(Mesocosm == paste("Mesocosm", mesocosm_number))
  
  # Check if there's data
  if(nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + 
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste("No data for Mesocosm", mesocosm_number)) + 
             theme_void())
  }
  
  # Get the unique days in the dataset
  days <- sort(unique(filtered_data$Day))
  
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Day, y = Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +  # Width less than 2 creates gaps
    scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(days) + 10, by = 10),  # Show ticks every 10 days
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x %% 10 == 0, paste("Day", x), ""),  # Only show labels for multiples of 10
      limits = c(min(days) - 2, max(days) + 2)  # Add space at edges
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lipid Composition in Mesocosm", mesocosm_number),
      x = "",  # Remove x-axis title
      y = "Percentage (%)",
      fill = "Lipid Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),  # Horizontal labels
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      # Agregar el marco/borde
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      # Asegurar que los ejes también tienen color
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# Función para crear gráficos para cada mesocosm (CON MARCO) - Bottom
plot_mesocosm_bottom <- function(mesocosm_number) {
  filtered_data <- lipids_bottom_for_plotting %>%
    filter(Mesocosm == paste("Mesocosm", mesocosm_number))
  
  # Verificar si hay datos
  if(nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + 
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste("No data for Mesocosm", mesocosm_number)) + 
             theme_void())
  }
  
  # Get the unique days in the dataset
  days <- sort(unique(filtered_data$Day))
  
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Day, y = Percentage, fill = Lipid_Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +  # Width less than 2 creates gaps
    scale_fill_manual(values = lipid_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(days) + 10, by = 10),  # Show ticks every 10 days
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x %% 10 == 0, x, ""),  # Only show labels for multiples of 10
      limits = c(min(days) - 2, max(days) + 2)  # Add space at edges
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lipid Composition in Mesocosm", mesocosm_number, "(Bottom)"),
      x = "",  # Eliminar título del eje x
      y = "Percentage (%)",
      fill = "Lipid Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),  # Horizontal labels
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      # Agregar el marco/borde
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      # Asegurar que los ejes también tienen color
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# Recrear los gráficos individuales
plot_surface_meso5 <- plot_mesocosm(5)
plot_surface_meso6 <- plot_mesocosm(6)
plot_surface_meso7 <- plot_mesocosm(7)
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
```

```{r}
# Cargar librerías necesarias
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Función para procesar datos de órdenes bacterianas con TODOS los filos
process_orders_data <- function(data) {
  # Eliminar las columnas ambientales (2 a 12)
  data_abundancias_reducido <- data[, -c(2:12)]
  
  # Crear una lista de grupos de órdenes por filo basada en los datos reales
  order_groups <- list(
    Proteobacteria = grep("^Proteobacteria\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Planctomycetota = grep("^Planctomycetota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Patescibacteria = grep("^Patescibacteria\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Verrucomicrobiota = grep("^Verrucomicrobiota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Bacteroidota = grep("^Bacteroidota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Campilobacterota = grep("^Campilobacterota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Bdellovibrionota = grep("^Bdellovibrionota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Desulfobacterota = grep("^Desulfobacterota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Marinimicrobia = grep("^Marinimicrobia_", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Chloroflexi = grep("^Chloroflexi\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Cyanobacteria = grep("^Cyanobacteria\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Actinobacteriota = grep("^Actinobacteriota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Procesar los datos
  datos_processed <- data_abundancias_reducido %>%
    mutate(
      Mesocosm = case_when(
        grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
        grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
        grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
        grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
    )
  
  # Calcular la suma de cada grupo de órdenes
  for (group_name in names(order_groups)) {
    if (length(order_groups[[group_name]]) > 0) {
      datos_processed[[group_name]] <- rowSums(datos_processed[, order_groups[[group_name]], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      datos_processed[[group_name]] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  # Calcular el total para obtener porcentajes
  order_columns <- names(order_groups)
  datos_processed$Total <- rowSums(datos_processed[, order_columns], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calcular porcentajes
  for (group_name in order_columns) {
    datos_processed[[group_name]] <- (datos_processed[[group_name]] / datos_processed$Total) * 100
  }
  
  # Convertir a formato largo para graficar
  datos_for_plotting <- datos_processed %>%
    select(ID, Mesocosm, Day, all_of(order_columns)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(order_columns),
      names_to = "Bacterial_Phylum",
      values_to = "Percentage"
    )
  
  return(datos_for_plotting)
}

# Procesar datos de Surface y Bottom
orders_surface_for_plotting <- process_orders_data(ordenes_surface_abundancias)
orders_bottom_for_plotting <- process_orders_data(ordenes_bottom_abundancias)

# Crear una paleta de colores para los 12 filos
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Proteobacteria" = "#1f77b4",     # Azul
  "Bacteroidota" = "#ff7f0e",       # Naranja
  "Verrucomicrobiota" = "#2ca02c",  # Verde
  "Cyanobacteria" = "#d62728",      # Rojo
  "Actinobacteriota" = "#9467bd",   # Púrpura
  "Planctomycetota" = "#8c564b",    # Marrón
  "Patescibacteria" = "#e377c2",    # Rosa
  "Campilobacterota" = "#7f7f7f",   # Gris
  "Bdellovibrionota" = "#bcbd22",   # Amarillo verdoso
  "Desulfobacterota" = "#17becf",   # Cian
  "Marinimicrobia" = "#aec7e8",     # Azul claro
  "Chloroflexi" = "#ffbb78"         # Naranja claro
)

# Función para crear gráficos para cada mesocosm
plot_mesocosm_orders <- function(mesocosm_number, data, sample_type = "Surface") {
  filtered_data <- data %>%
    filter(Mesocosm == paste("Mesocosm", mesocosm_number))
  
  if(nrow(filtered_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + 
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
                     label = paste("No data for Mesocosm", mesocosm_number)) + 
             theme_void())
  }
  
  days <- sort(unique(filtered_data$Day))
  
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Day, y = Percentage, fill = Bacterial_Phylum)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(days) + 10, by = 10),
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x %% 10 == 0, x, ""),
      limits = c(min(days) - 2, max(days) + 2)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Bacterial Phylum Composition in Mesocosm", mesocosm_number, paste0("(", sample_type, ")")),
      x = "",
      y = "Percentage (%)",
      fill = "Bacterial Phylum"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
}

plot_bottom_meso7_orders <- plot_mesocosm_orders(7, orders_bottom_for_plotting, "Bottom")
plot_bottom_meso8_orders <- plot_mesocosm_orders(8, orders_bottom_for_plotting, "Bottom")

# Combinar todos los gráficos - Surface arriba, Bottom abajo
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Promedio por Día (across mesocosms) -> relativización 0-100%
# ============================================================

# --- Surface ---
phylum_surface_average <- orders_surface_for_plotting %>%
  group_by(Day, Bacterial_Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Percentage = mean(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(Day_Total = sum(Avg_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
         Adjusted_Percentage = (Avg_Percentage / Day_Total) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Bottom (subsurface) ---
phylum_bottom_average <- orders_bottom_for_plotting %>%
  group_by(Day, Bacterial_Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Percentage = mean(Percentage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(Day_Total = sum(Avg_Percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
         Adjusted_Percentage = (Avg_Percentage / Day_Total) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Orden fijo del factor para que la leyenda/paleta sea consistente
phylum_order <- names(phylum_colors)
phylum_surface_average$Bacterial_Phylum <- factor(phylum_surface_average$Bacterial_Phylum, levels = phylum_order)
phylum_bottom_average$Bacterial_Phylum  <- factor(phylum_bottom_average$Bacterial_Phylum, levels = phylum_order)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 0. LIBRERÍAS
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1. PALETA DE COLORES (inspirada en Fig. 1 - tonos tierra/cálidos
#    para dominantes, fríos/pastel para menos abundantes)
# ============================================================
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Proteobacteria"     = "#8B5A2B",  # marrón cálido
  "Bacteroidota"       = "#E8B84B",  # amarillo mostaza
  "Verrucomicrobiota"  = "#C9A0DC",  # lila suave
  "Cyanobacteria"      = "#4C9A2A",  # verde
  "Actinobacteriota"   = "#D9895B",  # naranja tierra
  "Planctomycetota"    = "#7B6D8D",  # gris-violeta apagado
  "Patescibacteria"    = "#D9536A",  # rosado/coral
  "Campilobacterota"   = "#B5D96C",  # verde lima claro
  "Bdellovibrionota"   = "#5B7C99",  # azul grisáceo
  "Desulfobacterota"   = "#2E6F40",  # verde oscuro
  "Marinimicrobia"     = "#E3A857",  # naranja arena
  "Chloroflexi"        = "#A6CEE3"   # celeste claro
)

# ============================================================
# 2. GRUPOS DE FILOS (mismos patrones grep usados antes)
# ============================================================
build_order_groups <- function(data_abundancias_reducido) {
  list(
    Proteobacteria     = grep("^Proteobacteria\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Planctomycetota    = grep("^Planctomycetota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Patescibacteria    = grep("^Patescibacteria\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Verrucomicrobiota  = grep("^Verrucomicrobiota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Bacteroidota       = grep("^Bacteroidota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Campilobacterota   = grep("^Campilobacterota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Bdellovibrionota   = grep("^Bdellovibrionota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Desulfobacterota   = grep("^Desulfobacterota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Marinimicrobia     = grep("^Marinimicrobia_", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Chloroflexi        = grep("^Chloroflexi\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Cyanobacteria      = grep("^Cyanobacteria\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE),
    Actinobacteriota   = grep("^Actinobacteriota\\.", colnames(data_abundancias_reducido), value = TRUE)
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 3. FUNCIÓN: sumar abundancias CRUDAS por filo (sin % todavía)
# ============================================================
compute_raw_phylum_sums <- function(data) {
  data_abundancias_reducido <- data[, -c(2:12)]   # quitar variables ambientales
  order_groups <- build_order_groups(data_abundancias_reducido)

  datos_processed <- data_abundancias_reducido %>%
    mutate(
      Mesocosm = case_when(
        grepl("Mesocosm 5", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 5",
        grepl("Mesocosm 6", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 6",
        grepl("Mesocosm 7", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 7",
        grepl("Mesocosm 8", ID) ~ "Mesocosm 8",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Day = as.numeric(gsub(".*Day_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ID))
    )

  for (group_name in names(order_groups)) {
    if (length(order_groups[[group_name]]) > 0) {
      datos_processed[[group_name]] <- rowSums(datos_processed[, order_groups[[group_name]], drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      datos_processed[[group_name]] <- 0
    }
  }

  order_columns <- names(order_groups)
  datos_processed %>%
    select(ID, Mesocosm, Day, all_of(order_columns))
}

# ============================================================
# 4. APLICAR A SURFACE Y BOTTOM -> abundancias crudas por muestra
# ============================================================
raw_surface <- compute_raw_phylum_sums(ordenes_surface_abundancias)
raw_bottom  <- compute_raw_phylum_sums(ordenes_bottom_abundancias)

phylum_columns <- names(build_order_groups(ordenes_surface_abundancias[, -c(2:12)]))

# ============================================================
# 5. OPCIÓN B — PASO 1: promedio de valores CRUDOS entre mesocosms
#              PASO 2: relativizar ese promedio a 0-100%
# ============================================================
average_and_relativize <- function(raw_data, phylum_columns) {
  raw_data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(phylum_columns),
                 names_to = "Bacterial_Phylum", values_to = "Raw_Abundance") %>%
    group_by(Day, Bacterial_Phylum) %>%
    summarise(Avg_Raw_Abundance = mean(Raw_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Day) %>%
    mutate(Day_Total = sum(Avg_Raw_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
           Adjusted_Percentage = (Avg_Raw_Abundance / Day_Total) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
}

phylum_surface_average <- average_and_relativize(raw_surface, phylum_columns)
phylum_bottom_average  <- average_and_relativize(raw_bottom, phylum_columns)

# Orden fijo del factor (consistente con la paleta)
phylum_order <- names(phylum_colors)
phylum_surface_average$Bacterial_Phylum <- factor(phylum_surface_average$Bacterial_Phylum, levels = phylum_order)
phylum_bottom_average$Bacterial_Phylum  <- factor(phylum_bottom_average$Bacterial_Phylum, levels = phylum_order)

# ============================================================
# 6. GRÁFICO — misma estructura que la Figura 3 (sin línea, solo barras)
# ============================================================
phase_breaks <- c(11, 19, 37)
days_phylum_surface <- sort(unique(phylum_surface_average$Day))
days_phylum_bottom  <- sort(unique(phylum_bottom_average$Day))

surface_phylum_plot <- ggplot(phylum_surface_average,
       aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Bacterial_Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors, name = "Bacterial Phylum") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days_phylum_surface) + 10, by = 10),
    limits = c(min(days_phylum_surface) - 2, max(days_phylum_surface) + 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

bottom_phylum_plot <- ggplot(phylum_bottom_average,
       aes(x = Day, y = Adjusted_Percentage, fill = Bacterial_Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors, name = "Bacterial Phylum") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(days_phylum_bottom) + 10, by = 10),
    limits = c(min(days_phylum_bottom) - 2, max(days_phylum_bottom) + 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  labs(x = "Day") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. FRANJA DE FASES + ENSAMBLAJE FINAL
# ============================================================
phase_positions <- c(mean(c(0, 11)), mean(c(11, 19)), mean(c(19, 37)),
                      mean(c(37, max(days_phylum_bottom) + 2)))

phase_labels_plot_phylum <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = phase_positions, y = 0,
           label = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
           size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(days_phylum_bottom) - 2, max(days_phylum_bottom) + 2)) +
  theme_void()

final_phylum_plot <- phase_labels_plot_phylum / surface_phylum_plot / bottom_phylum_plot +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.5, 10, 10), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_phylum_plot <- final_phylum_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("", "A", "B"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(final_phylum_plot)

# --- ggsave() se agrega solo cuando confirmes que esta es la versión final ---
```

# coombinar ambos
```{r}
# ============================================================
# ENSAMBLAJE FINAL COMBINADO: Lípidos + Filos Bacterianos
# (requiere haber corrido ambos scripts individuales antes,
#  para tener disponibles los 4 paneles base)
# ============================================================
library(patchwork)

# --- Rango de días combinado (eje X compartido entre los 4 paneles) ---
all_days_combined <- c(days_surface, days_bottom, days_phylum_surface, days_phylum_bottom)
day_min_combined <- min(all_days_combined) - 2
day_max_combined <- max(all_days_combined) + 2

phase_breaks_combined <- c(11, 19, 37)

# --- Reconstruir los 4 paneles con el mismo eje X, y quitar ejes intermedios ---
surface_plot_final <- surface_plot_combined +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, day_max_combined, by = 10),
                      limits = c(day_min_combined, day_max_combined)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL)

bottom_plot_final <- bottom_plot_combined +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, day_max_combined, by = 10),
                      limits = c(day_min_combined, day_max_combined)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL)

surface_phylum_final <- surface_phylum_plot +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, day_max_combined, by = 10),
                      limits = c(day_min_combined, day_max_combined)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL)

bottom_phylum_final <- bottom_phylum_plot +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, day_max_combined, by = 10),
                      limits = c(day_min_combined, day_max_combined)) +
  labs(x = "Day")   # único panel con eje X visible, al final de la columna

# --- Franja de fases única y compartida ---
phase_positions_combined <- c(mean(c(0, 11)), mean(c(11, 19)), mean(c(19, 37)),
                               mean(c(37, day_max_combined)))

phase_labels_plot_combined <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = phase_positions_combined, y = 0,
           label = c("Phase I", "Phase II", "Phase III", "Phase IV"),
           size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = phase_breaks_combined, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(day_min_combined, day_max_combined)) +
  theme_void()

# --- Ensamblaje final ---
final_combined_plot <- phase_labels_plot_combined /
  surface_plot_final /
  bottom_plot_final /
  surface_phylum_final /
  bottom_phylum_final +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.5, 10, 10, 10, 10), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

final_combined_plot <- final_combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("", "A", "B", "C", "D"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(final_combined_plot)
```
